timer.title: Timer
timer.buttonHint: Press and hold to undo the last tap
timer.howBody1: Tap Start when a contraction begins and Stop when it ends. The app works out how long each one lasts and how far apart they are.
timer.howBody2: The gap is measured from the start of one contraction to the start of the next, the way midwives and doctors usually count.
timer.howBody3: If your provider gave you a pattern to watch for, such as 5-1-1, choose it in More, then Settings. The app only compares your numbers with it. Your provider decides what to do.
timer.clockChanged: Phone clock changed — times may be off
timer.longRunning: Still going? Tap Stop when it eases. If something feels wrong, call your provider.
timer.idlePrompt: Looks like things calmed down. End this session?
timer.undoBody: This takes back your last Start or Stop.

kicks.title: Kicks
kicks.tip: Find a comfortable spot. Tap once for each movement. Movements within a second of each other count as one.
kicks.startedTip: Tap Start whenever you're ready to count.
kicks.countLabel: Count a movement. {n} of {target} so far
kicks.softLimit: It's been 2 hours. If you've noticed fewer movements than usual, contact your provider today.
kicks.hardClosed: This count ended after 3 hours and was saved.
kicks.historyEmpty: No counts yet. When you save one, it will be kept here, only on this phone.
kicks.sparkLabel: Minutes to reach the target over your last {n} counts: from {first} to {last}

pregnancy.title: My Pregnancy
pregnancy.noDue: Add your due date to see your week
pregnancy.noDueBody: Your week, the days to go and your baby's size all come from it. It stays on this phone.
pregnancy.pastDue: Past your due date — your provider will guide next steps.
pregnancy.sizeLine: Baby is about the size of a {size}
pregnancy.weekRowLabel: Week {n}: about the size of a {size}
pregnancy.weekRowCurrentLabel: Week {n}, this week: about the size of a {size}
pregnancy.bagNudgeBody: A good time to look at your list.

stats.tapHint: Tap to see what this means
stats.explainCount: How many contractions you timed in the last 60 minutes. Very short taps, under 10 seconds, are left out because they are most likely a mis-tap.
stats.explainLength: The average time from the start to the end of each contraction in the last hour.
stats.explainInterval: The average time from the start of one contraction to the start of the next, over the last hour. A gap of more than 30 minutes is left out.
stats.label: {title}: {value}

last.title: Last contraction
last.none: Nothing timed yet. Tap Start when the next one begins.
last.label: Last contraction, {length} long, {gap} after the one before

pattern.banner: Your last hour matches the {rule} pattern your provider mentioned. It may be time to call them.
pattern.bannerCustom: Your recent contractions match the pattern you set in the app. It may be time to call your provider.

channel.timingDescription: A gentle note if a timing session is left open
channel.kickDescription: Your daily reminder to count kicks
channel.weeklyDescription: Once a week, how big your baby is

notifications.sessionOpen: Still timing? Your session is open. Tap to review or end it.

summary.title: Contraction summary — {date}
summary.noAverages: No finished contractions in this hour
summary.ruleMatched: Pattern rule set in app: {rule} → matched at {time}
summary.ruleNotMatched: Pattern rule set in app: {rule} → no match recorded
summary.ruleCustom: custom (every {interval} min or less, {length} s or longer, for {sustain} min)
summary.footer: Recorded with Contraction Timer. This is a personal log, not a medical assessment. Not medical advice.

history.title: History
history.empty: No sessions yet. When the time comes, everything you time will be saved here — only on this phone.
history.row: {date}, {start} to {end}, {count} contractions, average length {length}, average gap {gap}

session.title: Session
session.notFound: This session is no longer on the phone.
session.deleteBody: This removes it from the phone. It cannot be undone.
session.inProgressNote: This session is still open. Ending it is done on the Timer.

edit.notePlaceholder: A note for yourself or your provider

errors.end-before-start: The end cannot be before the start.
errors.too-short: It needs to last at least a second.
errors.in-future: That time has not happened yet.
errors.too-long: A contraction cannot be longer than 30 minutes here.
errors.overlaps: That overlaps another contraction. Move it so they do not overlap.
errors.not-found: That contraction is not there any more.
errors.open: A contraction that is still being timed cannot be edited.

share.title: Share summary
share.intro: This is made on your phone and goes nowhere until you choose an app.
share.pdfFailed: Could not make the PDF. You can still share the text.
share.pdfUnavailable: Sharing files is not available on this phone. You can still share the text.
share.textFailed: Could not open the share sheet.

reminder.title: Daily kick reminder
reminder.body: We can send one quiet reminder a day at the time you choose. You can turn it off whenever you like.
reminder.denied: No problem. You can turn reminders on later in More.
reminder.blocked: Notifications are turned off for this app in your phone's settings.
reminder.notificationBody: Time for your kick count? Find a comfy spot and tap Start.

week.title: Week {n}
week.approx: Sizes and weights are rough averages. Every baby is different.
week.disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Your midwife or doctor knows your situation best.
week.notFound: There is no card for this week.

due.title: Due date calculator
due.modeLmp: First day of my last period
due.fieldLmp: First day of your last period
due.cycleNote: 28 days is the usual figure. Change it if your cycles are shorter or longer.

errors.lmp-future: That date has not happened yet.
errors.lmp-too-old: That is more than 44 weeks ago. Check the date.
errors.date-future: That date has not happened yet.
errors.edd-too-early: That due date is more than 4 weeks ago. Check the date.
errors.edd-too-late: That due date is more than 42 weeks away. Check the date.

due.removeBody: Your week, days to go and weekly cards will go away until you add it again.

lists.bagIntro: Tick things off as you pack. Add your own, or take off what you don't need.
lists.planIntro: Things to think about and talk through with your provider. There are no right answers.
lists.templatesNote: Watch a short video to add one of these lists for good.
lists.includePlan: Include my birth plan in the text

weekly.body: Week {n}: baby is about the size of a {size} {emoji}
